plusgfmtype.title: Failure Analysis Type

Criticality-based maintenance identifies which assets are critical and what the impact would be if the assets were to fail. Criticality-based maintenance also informs procurement strategy so that inventories, and the costs associated with keeping them, are reduced but not at the expense of increased downtime.
